chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

verses.text: Blessed na di one wey dey think about di poor. Di Lord go deliver am for time of trouble.
Di Lord go preserve am and keep am alive. E go dey blessed for di land. You no go deliver am to di desire of im enemies.
Di Lord go sustain am on im sick bed. You go make all im bed new for im sickness.
I talk say, “Lord, have mercy on me. Heal my soul, because I don sin against you.”
My enemies dey talk evil about me say, “When e go die, and im name go perish?”
When one of dem come to see me, e dey talk empty words. Im heart dey gather wickedness to imself. When e go outside, e dey tell am.
All dem wey hate me dey whisper together against me. Dem dey plan evil against me.
Dem talk say, “Evil thing don stick for am. Now e don lie down, e no go rise again.”
Even my own close friend, wey I trust, wey eat my bread, don lift up im heel against me.
But you, Lord, have mercy on me and raise me up, so dat I go pay dem back.
By dis I know say you delight for me, because my enemy no triumph over me.
As for me, you uphold me for my integrity and set me before your face forever.
Blessed be di Lord, di God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Amen and amen.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. A contemplation by di sons of Korah.

verses.text: As di deer dey long for streams of water, so my soul dey long for you, God.
My soul dey thirst for God, for di living God. When I go come and appear before God?
My tears don be my food day and night, while dem dey talk to me all day say, “Where your God dey?”
I remember dis, and I pour out my soul inside me, how I dey go with di crowd and lead dem to God house, with voice of joy and thanksgiving, di multitude wey dey keep holy day.
Why you dey downcast, my soul? Why you dey disturbed inside me? Hope for God, because I go still praise am for di help of im presence.
My God, my soul dey downcast inside me. So I remember you from di land of Jordan, di peaks of Hermon, from Mount Mizar.
Deep dey call to deep for di noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows don pass over me.
By day di Lord go command im faithful love. For night im song go dey with me, prayer to di God of my life.
I go talk to God, my rock, say, “Why you don forget me? Why I dey go about mourning because of di oppression of di enemy?”
As with sword for my bones, my enemies dey mock me, while dem dey talk to me all day say, “Where your God dey?”
Why you dey downcast, my soul? Why you dey disturbed inside me? Hope for God, because I go still praise am, di help of my face and my God.
Defend me, God, and plead my cause against nation wey no dey faithful. Deliver me from deceitful and unjust man.
Because you be di God of my strength. Why you don reject me? Why I dey go about mourning because of di oppression of di enemy?
Oh send out your light and your truth. Make dem lead me. Make dem bring me to your holy hill and to your tents.
Den I go go to God altar, to God my exceeding joy. I go praise you with harp, God, my God.
Why you dey downcast, my soul? Why you dey disturbed inside me? Hope for God, because I go still praise am, di help of my face and my God.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. By di sons of Korah. A contemplation.

verses.text: We don hear with our ears, God. Our papa dem don tell us wetin you do for dem days, for di days of old.
You drive out di nations with your hand, but you plant dem. You afflict di peoples, but you spread dem out.
Because dem no win di land by dem own sword, and dem own arm no save dem, but your right hand and your arm and di light of your face, because you delight for dem.
You be my King, God. Command victories for Jacob.
Through you we go push down our enemies. Through your name we go tread down dem wey rise up against us.
Because I no go trust for my bow, and my sword no go save me.
But you don save us from our enemies and put dem wey hate us to shame.
For God we don boast all day long and we go praise your name forever. Selah.
But now you don reject us and bring us to shame. You no dey go out with our armies.
You make us turn back from di enemy. Dem wey hate us don take spoil for dem self.
You don give us like sheep for food and don scatter us among di nations.
You sell your people for nothing and no gain from dem price.
You make us shame to our neighbors, scorn and derision to dem wey dey round us.
You make us joke among di nations, shaking of head among di peoples.
All day my disgrace dey before me, and di shame of my face don cover me,
because of di voice of di one wey dey taunt and dey blaspheme, because of di enemy and di avenger.
All dis don come on us, but we no forget you, and we no deal falsely with your covenant.
Our heart no turn back, and our steps no turn aside from your way,
though you don crush us for di place of jackals and cover us with di shadow of death.
If we don forget di name of our God, or spread out our hands to strange gods,
God no go find dis out? Because e know di secrets of di heart.
Yes, for your sake dem dey kill us all day long. Dem count us as sheep for slaughter.
Wake up! Why you dey sleep, Lord? Rise up! No reject us forever.
Why you dey hide your face and forget our suffering and our oppression?
Because our soul don bow down to di dust. Our belly dey stick to di ground.
Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your faithful love.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. To di tune of Lilies. By di sons of Korah. A contemplation. A song of love.

verses.text: My heart dey overflow with good matter. I dey talk about di things wey I don make about di king. My tongue na di pen of ready writer.
You fine pass di sons of men. Grace dey pour on your lips. So God don bless you forever.
Gird your sword on your thigh, mighty one, your splendor and your majesty.
For your majesty ride on victoriously for di cause of truth and humility and righteousness. Your right hand go teach you awesome things.
Your arrows sharp. Peoples fall under you. Dem enter di heart of di king enemies.
Your throne, God, dey forever and ever. Di scepter of your kingdom na scepter of uprightness.
You love righteousness and hate wickedness. So God, your God, don anoint you with di oil of gladness above your fellows.
All your clothes smell like myrrh, aloes and cassia. Out of ivory palaces, stringed instruments don make you glad.
Kings daughters dey among your honorable women. For your right hand di queen dey stand with gold of Ophir.
Listen, daughter, consider and turn your ear. Forget your own people and your papa house.
So di king go desire your beauty, because e be your oga. Bow down to am.
Di daughter of Tyre dey dere with gift. Di rich among di people go seek your favor.
Di princess dey glorious inside. Im clothing na woven gold.
Dem go bring am to di king for embroidered clothing. Di virgins wey be im companions and follow am go dey brought to you.
Dem go dey brought with gladness and rejoicing. Dem go enter di king palace.
Instead of your papa dem, you go get your sons, wey you go make princes for all di earth.
I go make your name remembered for all generations. So di peoples go praise you forever and ever.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. By di sons of Korah. For alamoth. A song.

verses.text: God na our refuge and strength, help wey dey ready for trouble.
So we no go fear, even though di earth change and di mountains shake enter di heart of di sea,
though im waters roar and trouble, though di mountains shake with di swelling. Selah.
Dere dey river wey im streams dey make di city of God glad, di holy place of di tents of di Most High.
God dey inside am. E no go move. God go help am early for morning.
Di nations rage. Di kingdoms move. E raise im voice, di earth melt.
Di Lord of Armies dey with us. Di God of Jacob na our refuge. Selah.
Come, see di works of di Lord, wey don make desolations for di earth.
E make wars stop to di end of di earth. E break di bow and cut di spear in two. E burn di chariots for fire.
“Be still, and know say I be God. I go dey exalted among di nations. I go dey exalted for di earth.”
Di Lord of Armies dey with us. Di God of Jacob na our refuge. Selah.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. A Psalm by di sons of Korah.

verses.text: Clap your hands, all una peoples! Shout to God with voice of triumph!
Because di Lord Most High dey awesome. E be great King over all di earth.
E subdue peoples under us and nations under our feet.
E choose our inheritance for us, di glory of Jacob wey e love. Selah.
God don go up with shout, di Lord with di sound of trumpet.
Sing praises to God, sing praises. Sing praises to our King, sing praises.
Because God na di King of all di earth. Sing praises with understanding.
God reign over di nations. God sit for im holy throne.
Di princes of di peoples don gather together as di people of di God of Abraham, because di shields of di earth belong to God. E dey greatly exalted.

chapters.title: A song. A Psalm by di sons of Korah.

verses.text: Great na di Lord, and e suppose get plenty praise for di city of our God, im holy mountain.
Beautiful for height, di joy of all di earth, na Mount Zion, for di far north, di city of di great King.
God dey inside im palaces. E don make imself known as refuge.
Because look, di kings assemble. Dem pass by together.
Dem see am, den dem amaze. Dem terrified. Dem hurry away.
Trembling take hold of dem dere, pain like woman wey dey born pikin.
With di east wind you break di ships of Tarshish.
As we don hear, so we don see for di city of di Lord of Armies, for di city of our God. God go establish am forever. Selah.
We don think about your faithful love, God, inside your temple.
As your name, God, so your praise reach to di ends of di earth. Your right hand full of righteousness.
Make Mount Zion rejoice. Make di daughters of Judah be glad because of your judgments.
Waka about Zion and go round am. Count im towers.
Mark well im ramparts. Consider im palaces, so dat una go tell di next generation.
Because dis God na our God forever and ever. E go be our guide even to death.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. A Psalm by di sons of Korah.

verses.text: Hear dis, all una peoples. Listen, all una wey dey live for di world,
both low and high, rich and poor together.
My mouth go speak wisdom. Di meditation of my heart go be understanding.
I go bend my ear to proverb. I go open my riddle with di harp.
Why I go fear for days of evil, when di iniquity of my heels surround me?
Dem wey trust for dem wealth and boast for di abundance of dem riches,
none of dem fit by any means redeem im brother or give God ransom for am.
Because di redemption of dem soul dey costly, and e no go ever happen,
so dat e go live on forever and no see di pit.
Because e see say even wise men die. Di fool and di senseless perish together and leave dem wealth to others.
Dem inner thought na say dem houses go last forever, dem dwelling places to all generations. Dem dey name dem lands after dem own names.
But man no go last for im glory. E dey like di animals wey perish.
Dis na di way of dem wey dey foolish and of dem wey dey follow dem and approve dem words. Selah.
Dem dey appointed like sheep for Sheol. Death go be dem shepherd. Di upright go rule over dem for di morning. Dem beauty go waste away for Sheol, wey no get place to stay.
But God go redeem my soul from di power of Sheol, because e go receive me. Selah.
No dey afraid when man become rich, when di glory of im house increase.
Because when e die, e no go carry anything away. Im glory no go go down after am.
Though while e dey alive e bless im soul, and men dey praise you when you do well for yourself,
e go join di generation of im papa dem. Dem no go ever see light.
Man wey get riches but no get understanding dey like di animals wey perish.
Di Mighty One, God, di Lord, don speak and call di earth from di rising of di sun to im setting.
Out of Zion, di perfection of beauty, God don shine out.
Our God dey come and no go keep silent. Fire dey devour before am, and storm dey rage round am.
E call to di heavens above and to di earth, so dat e go judge im people:
“Gather my holy ones to me, dem wey don make covenant with me by sacrifice.”
Di heavens go declare im righteousness, because God imself na judge. Selah.
“Hear, my people, and I go speak. Israel, I go testify against you. I be God, your God.
I no go rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings dey always before me.
I no go take bull from your house or male goat from your pens.
Because every animal of di forest na my own, and di cattle on thousand hills.
I know all di birds of di mountains. Di wild animals of di field na my own.
If I hungry, I no go tell you, because di world na my own, and all wey full am.
I go eat di flesh of bulls or drink di blood of goats?
Offer to God thanksgiving. Pay your vows to di Most High.
Call on me for di day of trouble. I go deliver you, and you go glorify me.”
But to di wicked God talk say, “Wetin you get to do with declaring my statutes, or to take my covenant for your mouth,
seeing say you hate instruction and throw my words behind you?
When you see thief, you agree with am, and you dey join adulterers.
You dey give your mouth to evil, and your tongue dey form deceit.
You sit and speak against your brother. You slander your own mama pikin.
Dis things you don do, and I keep silent. You think say I be just like you. But I go rebuke you and set dem in order before your eyes.
Now consider dis, una wey forget God, or I go tear una to pieces, and nobody go deliver.
Anyone wey offer thanksgiving as im sacrifice dey honor me, and to di one wey order im way right I go show di salvation of God.”
